source_text: Religious rationales, though not explicitly mandated by the Quran, draw on select hadiths referencing "female circumcision" as a virtuous Islamic practice (sunna), with leaders like Imam Abdoulie Fatty and the Gambia Supreme Islamic Council framing it as essential for piety and cultural preservation against external impositions. [18]
